items.title: Ghost in the Machine | Full Documentary
items.description:
Ghost in the Machine, directed by Valerie Veatch
Artificial intelligence is now part of everyday life. But what forces created it?
"Ghost in the Machine" traces the origins of "AI" and excavates the cultural, political, and philosophical drivers behind a worldwide "AI" boom.
